visible_strengths: The forest region (Image 1) displays strong visual cohesion with consistent tree silhouettes and naturalistic shadowing that grounds the objects in a believable environment.

The close-up views of Corruptos and Engendro (Images 3 & 4) maintain a consistent visual style with the rest of the world, using muted, desaturated tones to imply corruption without introducing distracting elements.

highest_impact_defects.observation: The forest region (Image 1) suffers from a lack of ground contact and visual clarity. The trees appear to float slightly above the terrain, and the ground texture is uniformly flat, lacking the subtle variations that would enhance realism.
highest_impact_defects.correction: Introduce subtle terrain undulations and add small-scale ground detail (e.g., grass patches, dirt clods) beneath the trees to establish a more grounded and textured surface.

highest_impact_defects.observation: The quarry (Image 2) has poor visual clarity due to the heavy, uniform fog that obscures the details of the rock formation and structures, making the scene feel flat and indistinct.
highest_impact_defects.correction: Adjust the fog density and add directional lighting to illuminate the quarry's features, ensuring that the rock textures and small structures remain visible and distinct.

highest_impact_defects.observation: The close-up views of Corruptos and Engendro (Images 3 & 4) lack visual cohesion with the rest of the world. The dark, floating rock formations appear disconnected from the environment and do not cast convincing shadows or interact with the terrain.
highest_impact_defects.correction: Anchor the rock formations to the ground with visible contact points and add dynamic, directionally consistent shadows to integrate them into the scene and reinforce their physical presence.
